title: 1RB0RE_0RC0RF_1LD1RA_1RE0LD_0LB1RC_1LE---: the small gaps after a rebuild follow a 7-state automaton; checked rebuild map proved to rebuild 200
text: The transient after each rebuild reads only the lowest 3J bits of the counter, where J is decided by a 7-state automaton on 3-bit groups; the list gains 4J − 1 units and the next rebuild state is arithmetic on three numbers (checked on rebuilds 4 to 200 and on 1,000 random states; it reaches rebuild 2,000 in 7 minutes without a halt). In Lean the map is a checker with a soundness proof: the kernel evaluates each transient on short prefixes only, and the run from blank tape is proved to rebuild 200 (a single block of 54,075 cells, more than 10<sup>5,425</sup> steps), up from rebuild 40.
